Meanwhile, Agnes spots a golden opportunity to climb the social ladder thanks to a presidential dinner, Marian is going out on her own and looking for some independence, and Peggy is trying to settle in with her new family.

How to watch The Gilded Age season 4 in the US
The Gilded Age season 4 premieres on HBO at 9pm ET/PT on Sunday, November 1 . Further episodes will go out one at a time in the same slot weekly.
If you don't already have access to HBO, you can still watch The Gilded Age season 4 and all of its programming online thanks to the HBO Max streaming platform. Have one of these subscriptions but away when The Gilded Age season 4 is on? You can still access your usual streaming services from anywhere by using a VPN .
How to watch The Gilded Age season 4 in the UK
The Gilded Age season 4 will go out on Sky Atlantic in the UK. Note that episodes in the UK will air a day after their US release, at 9pm on Mondays, from November 2 .
Episodes will also be available on catchup on Sky, as well as on the recently launched HBO Max service. It comes free with Sky TV plans, or you can get a standalone subscription from just £5.99 a month.
A further way to watch The Gilded Age season 4 in the UK is with a NOW Entertainment Membership from £6.99 a month.
Away from home? You can still connect to your usual streaming services by downloading a VPN and pointing your location back to the UK.
How to watch The Gilded Age season 4 in Canada
Crave is home to The Gilded Age season 4 in Canada, and follows the same weekly schedule as the US, with new episodes released every Sunday from November 1.
Prices start at CA$11.99/month and CA$119.99/year.
Away from home? You can access your subscriptions by downloading a VPN and pointing your location back to the UK.
How to watch The Gilded Age season 4 in Australia
If you're living Down Under, you will need Paramount+ to tune in to episodes of The Gilded Age season 4, with prices starting from $11.99 a month and episodes landing weekly from Monday, November 2 .
Outside Australia? Aussies away from home can use a VPN to unblock Paramount+ and watch The Gilded Age season 4 as they would at home.
When is the The Gilded Age season 4 release date?
The Gilded Age season 4 will premiere on Sunday, November 1 in the US, before landing in the UK and Australia a day later.
New episodes will arrive weekly thereafter across the next seven weeks, until the finale on December 20/21.
